tag: Past experience: 了 vs 过
focus: Distinguish a completed event from previous experience.
Distinguish later-than-expected from earlier-than-expected timing or amount.

tag: Ability and permission: 会 vs 可以
focus: Distinguish learned ability from permission or situational possibility.

tag: Duration: 一直 vs 总是
focus: Distinguish continuous duration from habitual repetition.
Distinguish attempting an action from achieving its result.
Distinguish an unexpected reversal from a simple contrast.

tag: Reported discovery: 原来 vs 竟然
focus: Distinguish newly realized information from surprise at an unexpected fact.

tag: Near synonyms: 认为 vs 觉得
focus: Distinguish formal reasoned opinion from personal feeling or impression.

tag: Near synonyms: 知道 vs 了解
focus: Distinguish knowing a fact from being familiar with a person, situation, or subject.

tag: Causation: 因为 vs 由于
focus: Distinguish ordinary conversational cause from formal written cause.

tag: Future intention: 要 vs 会
focus: Distinguish intention or obligation from a prediction about what will happen.
Distinguish direct comparison with 比 from intensifying a quality with 更.
Distinguish general or future negation from negating a completed action or past state.
Distinguish possession or existence from location.
Distinguish doing something again in the future from repetition in the past or present.
Distinguish a small expected number from an open-ended quantity question.

tag: Invitation: 一起 vs 一块儿
focus: Distinguish neutral and colloquial ways to say together, without claiming they are interchangeable in every context.

tag: Change of state: 了 vs 起来
focus: Distinguish a completed or newly relevant state from the beginning of an action or perception.
Identify which detail is being emphasized about a past event: time, place, manner, or person.
Distinguish focusing on what happens to a specific object from a neutral action statement.
Distinguish an affected subject and an adverse or notable outcome from an active statement.

tag: Ongoing state: 在 vs 着
focus: Distinguish an action in progress from a continuing state resulting from an action.

tag: Approximation: 差不多 vs 大概
focus: Distinguish near-equality from an estimated, uncertain quantity or time.

tag: Concession: 虽然……但是…… vs 尽管
focus: Distinguish an explicit paired concession from a more compact concessive framing.

tag: Hypothesis: 即使 vs 哪怕
focus: Distinguish formal conditional concession from an emphatic even-if condition.

tag: Unexpectedness: 居然 vs 竟然
focus: Distinguish closely related surprise markers by register and strength without inventing a false hard rule.

tag: Restriction: 只是 vs 不过
focus: Distinguish a limiting qualification from a mild contrast or transition.

tag: Speaker stance: 难怪 vs 怪不得
focus: Distinguish two ways of recognizing that a result now makes sense, including register.

tag: Discourse: 至于 vs 关于
focus: Distinguish shifting to a separate topic from introducing the subject under discussion.
Distinguish inclusive allness from addition or similarity, especially with negation.

tag: Location questions: 哪 vs 哪里
focus: Distinguish the short interrogative 哪 from the place expression 哪里 in natural questions.

tag: Small amount: 一点儿 vs 有点儿
focus: Distinguish a small quantity from a slight, often undesirable, degree.

tag: Progressive action: 正在 vs 在
focus: Distinguish explicit emphasis on an action in progress from the more neutral progressive marker.

tag: Choice: 还是 vs 或者
focus: Distinguish alternatives in a question from alternatives in a statement, command, or suggestion.
Distinguish a wish or plan from a stronger need, intention, or imminent future.
Distinguish what happens first from what should happen afterward.
Distinguish a starting point from the distance or relation between places.
Distinguish the usual spoken quantity form from the numeral used in numbers and ordered expressions.

tag: Time span: 以后 vs 的时候
focus: Distinguish after a point in time from at the time when an event happens.

tag: Common error: 有 vs 是
focus: Identify when a sentence needs existence or possession rather than an identifying copula.
Distinguish emphatic inclusion of an extreme case from an ordinary statement of quantity.
Distinguish two concurrent actions from a sequence of actions.
Distinguish an ongoing directional change from an ordinary comparison.
Distinguish a reliably immediate sequence from a simple temporal order.
Distinguish excluding an item from adding another item, including polarity-sensitive readings.
Distinguish taking an accepted premise as the basis for a conclusion from simple causation.
Distinguish two simultaneous qualities from repeated events or sequential actions.

tag: Topic marking: 对 vs 对于
focus: Distinguish a conversational relation or attitude from a more formal topic framing.
Distinguish direction toward a target from motion toward a place, without overstating the contrast.
Identify an inappropriate measure word by comparing it with the natural classifier in context.

tag: Qualified certainty: 未必 vs 不一定
focus: Distinguish a literary or formal challenge to an assumption from a neutral statement of uncertainty.
Identify how 不见得 gently challenges a conclusion without asserting its opposite.
Distinguish adding another practical reason from returning to an earlier point in time.
Distinguish an even stronger supporting case from a basic causal explanation.
Identify when a speaker frames alternatives as leading to the same result.
Distinguish invoking a decisive background fact from merely sequencing an argument.

tag: Inference: 看来 vs 好像
focus: Distinguish a conclusion drawn from evidence from an appearance or tentative impression.
Identify the frustration or irony added when something happens against expectation.
Distinguish an extreme included case from a simple addition.
Distinguish naming or questioning a label from simply stating a fact.
